response.text:
Draft/Notes:
Portrait poster — glass greenhouse at night (vertical 2:3). Photorealistic, centered tall greenhouse with warm amber interior light spilling through clear panes against cool moonlit exterior; dense tropical plants, ferns, and visible silhouettes inside; subtle condensation and reflections on glass, low drifting mist, starry sky and dark trees in background. Low-angle, slightly off-center view, cinematic depth, dramatic contrast, moody teal-blue and amber palette, high detail, sharp focus, negative space at top for title and clean margins for text.
